answer: To resist Sybils, require every identity to act as a relay in a juniper-shaped routing tree, continuously forwarding real traffic and emitting a signed pulse every few minutes proving sustained bandwidth and low latency. A zephyr of test packets is injected at random times and must be echoed within a strict deadline, so identities sharing one pipe or one machine cannot fake many independent relays: each fake adds latency and cost, while honest relays earn in proportion to verified throughput.
